about_the_game:
Castaway Survival Simulator is a turn-based card survival game. Explore and gather resources. Craft cards to build tools, hunt, and farm. Delve deeper to find secrets and powerful new recipes. Plan your moves and build a raft to escape. Every decision could be your last. Will you survive?

Feature List:

- Card System: Hundreds of cards to collect and combine

- Turn-Based Gameplay: No need to race against time—think through your strategy at your own pace

- Crafting System: Process raw materials into tools, shelters, and more

- Foraging & Farming: Choose how you get your food—farming offers a stable supply

- Hunting & Taming: Animals can be your prey—or your companions, if you treat them well
